The distillation carries many inline [V] quotations but no blockquotes; its own line 181 says no verbatim blockquotes appear, which is literally true. Grouped findings: D016 covers lines 74 and 76; D017 covers lines 78, 97, 123, 186; D019 covers 108-109; D036 covers 225 and 235; each counts once in the tally.
